description:
SURFACED by the fz-iib adversarial audit. The `nil`/`[]` typing fix (fz-iib) confirmed by exhaustive trace that `[]` patterns NEVER reach dispatch_const_ty as a GroundValue::EmptyList const: append_list_pattern (dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:667-700) lowers `[]` to Region::List(ListRegion::Empty) via RegionQuestion::list_empty — a structurally distinct region kind. Every consumer of DispatchShape::EmptyList independently treats it as unreachable-from-source: native.rs:4686 -> Err(FatalError); body.rs:1991-1999 -> LOWER_UNSUPPORTED diagnostic; ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs:559 -> None. And list literals are rejected in guard expressions entirely (guard_expr_from_ast has no Expr::List arm), so `x == []` in a guard cannot construct one either. So GroundValue::EmptyList / DispatchShape::EmptyList exists only for closed-match completeness (kept with a comment at semantic.rs by fz-iib).

DECIDE and either fold or delete (CLAUDE.md 'cares as much about what we remove'; NORTH STAR 'fold concordant ideas'):
(a) FOLD: unify `[]` matching to flow through the same dispatch-const machinery as other ground literals (collapse the two ways of expressing 'compare against a ground list shape' into one) -- IF the region-kind split isn't load-bearing; OR
(b) DELETE: if the Region::List(ListRegion::Empty/Cons) split is intentionally permanent (list matching needs cons/tail projections a flat Region::Equal can't express), remove GroundValue::EmptyList + DispatchShape::EmptyList as dead scaffolding rather than carrying an unreachable arm.

Investigate whether the region split is load-bearing (cons/tail projection needs) before choosing. Related: fz-iib, fz-yj0 (the fold that introduced GroundValue::EmptyList as a distinct leaf), fz-go4.51.

comments.text: Folded at d9718f2de. DECISION: DELETE (not fold) -- adversarial audit independently confirmed the region split (Region::List Empty/Cons) is load-bearing (needs runtime cons-cell predicates a flat Region::Equal const can't express), and GroundValue::EmptyList was DEAD-ON-ARRIVAL since fz-v19.1 (never had a producer; carried for closed-match completeness through fz-yj0.1/.5). Deleted GroundValue::EmptyList + DispatchShape::EmptyList + the ReceiveValue::EmptyList cascade + all unreachable consumer arms; gave Region::List(Empty) its own emit_list_empty_test (audit verified byte-for-byte equivalent to the old borrowed ground-const path). nil != [] intent preserved (nil stays the atom; [] is now provably never a GroundValue). Net -40 lines. Verified: lib 1241/0/6, matrix 19 known-red, clippy+fmt clean; three-path runtime proof via fixtures2/behavior/receive_list_cons_pattern (run/interp/build all green). Follow-up fz-go4.55 filed (ReceiveValue::Null/ValueKind::NULL is dead by the same mechanism).

title: [BUG] DispatchShape::EmptyList is dead-in-practice: [] patterns lower to Region::List(ListRegion::Empty), never a GroundValue::EmptyList dispatch const — decide fold-or-delete
